A. It aims to connect all Gram Panchayats in India with a high-speed optical fiber network.

questions.explanation_english: The BharatNet project is designed to connect all Gram Panchayats across India with high-speed optical fiber networks, and it is funded through the Universal Service Obligation Fund (USOF). questions.question_english:
23. What is the primary economic implication of a
persistent current account deficit (CAD) for an
emerging market like India?
options_english: Increased reliance on foreign capital inflows to balance foreign exchange gaps
Automatic structural appreciation of the domestic currency in foreign exchange markets
Widespread deflationary pressures across domestic consumer goods and services sectors
Total elimination of the sovereign public debt burden and fiscal deficit challenges
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (c) Widespread deflationary pressures across domestic consumer goods and services sectors. A persistent current account deficit indicates that a country is importing more goods and services than it is exporting, leading to a reliance on foreign capital. This can create deflationary pressures as the currency may depreciate, making imports more expensive and reducing domestic consumption. The economic implications can lead to a slowdown in growth and increased vulnerability to external shocks.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। एक स्थायी चालू खाता घाटा (CAD) का अर्थ है कि एक देश अपने निर्यात की तुलना में अधिक वस्तुएं और सेवाएं आयात कर रहा है, जिससे विदेशी पूंजी पर निर्भरता बढ़ती है। यह घरेलू उपभोक्ता वस्तुओं और सेवाओं के क्षेत्रों में व्यापक अवस्फीति दबाव उत्पन्न कर सकता है। मुद्रा के अवमूल्यन के कारण आयात महंगे हो जाते हैं, जिससे घरेलू उपभोग में कमी आती है। इसके आर्थिक परिणाम विकास में मंदी और बाहरी झटकों के प्रति बढ़ती संवेदनशीलता हो सकते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Widespread deflationary pressures across domestic consumer goods and services sectors

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: A persistent current account deficit indicates that a country is importing more goods and services than it is exporting, leading to reliance on foreign capital.

questions.question_english: 51. The 'Open Network for Digital Commerce' (ONDC) is an initiative launched in India primarily aimed at:

Nationalizing major foreign e-commerce companies operating in domestic markets
Democratizing e-commerce through an open-network architecture for merchants
Replacing physical paper currency entirely with central bank issued digital gold
questions.explanation_english: The Open Network for Digital Commerce is a government-backed initiative designed to democratize digital trade by transitioning e-commerce from platform-centric models to an open network architecture.
